subsystem: UIKitCore Scroll Indicators & Touch Interaction Subsystem

ivars.name: _knob
ivars.description: Child view hosting the visible rounded pill layer

ivars.name: _expanded
ivars.description: State flag toggling between collapsed (3.0pt) and interactive expanded (8.0pt) thickness

variables.L_track: Usable indicator track length = L_viewport - 2 * track_margin

boundary_conditions.extreme_content_length: lim_{L_content -> inf} L_indicator = L_min (clamped at 36.0 pt)
boundary_conditions.track_length_constraint: When L_track < L_min, L_indicator is clamped to L_track, ensuring indicator length never exceeds usable track span.

overscroll_compression.formula: L_compressed = max(min(W_indicator, L_track), L_indicator - abs(delta_overscroll) / r_compression)

parameters.top_overscroll_pinning: When offset < 0, knob position is pinned to track_start while length compresses from bottom edge.
parameters.bottom_overscroll_pinning: When offset > max_offset, knob bottom is pinned to track_end while length compresses and top edge advances.
parameters.nonlinear_coupling: Coupled with Phase 3C rational drag resistance y_overscroll = (x_finger * c * d) / (d + c * x_finger), producing non-linear monotonic compression asymptotically bounded by 3.0pt.
parameters.track_length_constraint: On ultra-constrained viewports where L_track < W_indicator, minimum clamped length is bounded by L_track to prevent track overflow.

direct_scaling_formula.fidelity: Provides continuous 1:1 proportional scrubbing across large multi-thousand-point scroll extents.
direct_scaling_formula.zoom_scale_adaptation: L_content is scaled by zoomScale (effectiveContentLength = L_content * zoomScale) to ensure direct scrubbing factor accurately maps across zoomed viewports.
direct_scaling_formula.multitouch_mutual_exclusion: Indicator scrubbing locks out concurrent pinch-to-zoom gestures, and active pinch zooming suppresses scroll indicator touch acquisition.

triggers: Indicator engagement / touch down on expanded knob
Boundary impact on initial transition when scrubbing reaches top/left or bottom/right limit (isolated single trigger, suppressed during continued stationary stalling)

trigger_events: Pan gesture recognizer state transitions to Began / Changed

hit_target_expansion.bounds_expansion_formula: CGRectInset(indicator_bounds, -dx, -dy) where dx, dy expand rect to at least 44.0 x 44.0 pt
hit_target_expansion.horizontal_indicator_padding: Applies symmetrical 44.0pt vertical padding to horizontal scroll indicator along height dimension.
hit_target_expansion.bidirectional_expansion: Pads both width and height symmetrically so that hitFrame is at least 44.0 x 44.0 pt, guaranteeing touch acquisition even when indicator is compressed down to 3.0pt under extreme overscroll.

presentation_layer_catch.action: Pins model offset to presentation layer bounds origin, halts CADisplayLink momentum ticking, and swallows touch event to prevent inadvertent subview clicks.

coordinate_conversion.usage: Transforms touch coordinates from UIWindow root space to presentation layer coordinates during in-flight scrolling to evaluate accurate child subview hit-testing.
